authorization: User requested implementation of G0 and G1; this is not brand sign-off or human gold labeling

formats.pdf: native + Poppler count + full-raster Tesseract chi_sim/eng; quality remains provisional
formats.docx: XML part inventory, text/table/image enumeration; unsupported layout/revisions explicitly blocked
formats.txt: decode complete bounded text, preserve every nonempty line and line counts
formats.doc: preview only; blocked in integrity pipeline; convert and verify DOCX
formats.xlsx: not admitted as Brief; existing script viewer unaffected

status_contract.processing_complete: Exact expected page/structural-unit keys vs persisted processed outputs; no missing/duplicate IDs

roles.material_owner: User must later declare full source package; not pre-filled

hard_rules: No semantic completeness inferred from page processing/OCR confidence
Do not modify legacy assets/source_blocks/rulesets/runs/human decisions
Whole-document acknowledgments do not become machine OCR proof
Existing two Briefs are development-family samples, never a held-out set

qualification_hardware.capacity_gate: G5; not qualified by the two Briefs

call_budget.g2_enable_requires: Versioned model window/call/token/quota budget before semantic jobs may execute

statistical_preregistration.critical: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound; gate >=0.97 plus observed recall >=0.99
statistical_preregistration.grouping: Report document/project worst cases and project-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals (10000 draws, seed=20261028); insufficient independent groups is insufficient evidence
statistical_preregistration.denominator: frozen independently human-adjudicated holdout only; two Briefs here excluded
statistical_preregistration.missing_outcomes: Count every unread/unknown required span against recall; never drop difficult inputs
statistical_preregistration.human_work: Report suspected gap proportion and total human minutes per 100 physical PDF pages; no timing inferred from machine execution
